name: Virgin
overview: Scripture presents the virgin as a person whose purity and character are to be carefully protected and honored, as seen in the requirement for proofs of virginity brought before city elders when a husband falsely accuses his wife of not being a virgin (Deuteronomy 22:13-15). The dowry associated with virgins underscores the value placed on their purity and the seriousness of marriage commitments (Exodus 22:17). Additionally, Leviticus 21:14 highlights that priests were permitted to marry only virgins from their own people, emphasizing the importance of purity within the covenant community.
